judged_rule: every run is published: Code quality is the equal mean of Muse Spark 1.3 (muse, judged under v3.30 for Low to Extra-high and v3.30.1 for Max) and GPT-6.1 Sol (sol, judged under v3.30.2 and v3.30.3), who each reviewed every run
single_judge_rule: combined_single_judge recomputes the combined score with Code quality from one judge's reviewed score and intent recovery alone; it is a sensitivity figure, not the published score
intent_recovery_rule: When a submission passed no quirk family, intent recovery has no denominator and its 9 points move to the reviewed score for that submission (intent_recovery_redistributed); 0 Claude Fable 5.2 runs needed it
hidden_behaviour_fields: hidden_behaviours counts the task's fail-to-pass hidden tests; hidden_behaviours_fixed counts those the run passed

cost_fields.estimated_usd: Claude Code's own list-price total for the session (the last result receipt's total_cost_usd, which is cumulative over the session's receipts), the cost basis of every Claude column; the adapter's own estimate prices cached prompt tokens at the full input rate and is not used

token_fields.raw_tokens: input, cache read, cache creation and output tokens, summed over every result receipt
token_fields.token_usage.thinking_tokens: the part of output Claude Code reports as thinking, from the raw stream (the run summaries do not record it)
token_fields.result_receipts: result receipts in the stream: two where a background task resumed the session after the model stopped, both counted

integrity_fields.writes_outside_workspace: the audit saw files written outside the workspace; every one was scratch space under the temporary directory, none is a benchmark data or answer-key path

model_identity: harness-recorded: Claude Code reports the serving model on every reply, and every reply in every run is claude-fable-5-2; the refusal fallback never answered
